name: MFA for Privileged Access
description: Privileged accounts must use multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Enable MFA on the privileged account immediately.

name: Security Awareness Training
description: Security awareness training must be completed every 180 days.
remediation: Schedule the overdue awareness training module.

name: Least Privilege for Admin Access
description: Admin access is limited to approved security and IT roles.
remediation: Remove admin rights or move the user to an approved role.

name: Encryption of Sensitive Data
description: PII and Restricted data must be encrypted at rest.
remediation: Enable encryption at rest before further processing.

name: Contractor Elevated Access
description: Contractors must not hold write or admin access without review.
remediation: Downgrade access or document a time-bound exception.

name: Dormant Account Containment
description: Disabled accounts must not retain active access.
remediation: Revoke all sessions and tokens for the disabled account.

name: MFA for Remote Access
remediation: Enforce MFA on the remote access gateway.

name: Password Rotation
description: Passwords older than 90 days must be rotated.
remediation: Prompt the user to rotate the password.

name: Restricted Data Retention
description: Restricted data must not be retained beyond 365 days.
remediation: Purge or archive the data under the retention policy.

name: Vendor Access Review
description: Vendor access must be reviewed at least every 90 days.
